text: I have exactly the same concern, and I’m becoming more and more convinced that the answer lies in the city you live in and the schools you send your children to. Unfortunately, I live in Ramla, and on a daily basis I get these “disappointed” reactions when people find out that I’m not Jewish. I’m afraid the solution may be to send the children to private schools or move to a different area — in Israel, even 10 km can make a huge difference.
